skill_name: Compare and contrast the two types of supervised machine learning.
workflow: Supervised learning is divided into two main types: classification and regression. In classification, the goal is to predict a categorical label such as a yes/no, true/false, or a number of discrete classes. In regression, the goal is to predict a continuous variable such as temperature or price. Both of these tasks are accomplished by learning a mapping from a set of input features to an output label or value.
